# Banuba WebAR runtime

Runtime binaries and segmentation modules in `v1.18.4` come from the installed
`@banuba/webar` package. `effects/Makeup.zip` comes from Banuba's official
`Banuba/beauty-web` example. Use of these assets requires a valid Banuba client
token and remains subject to Banuba's SDK agreement and trial/licence terms.

The application does not embed a client token in source control. Configure
`NEXT_PUBLIC_BANUBA_CLIENT_TOKEN` in the hosting environment.
